title: Design System: 股息站 Dividend Hub

body.purpose: 一般敘述文字、標籤、說明。

data.purpose: 價格、股數、百分比、代碼、時間戳等數字性質資料。

shadows.name: overlay-shadow
shadows.purpose: Dialog 容器，標示懸浮於頁面之上。

shadows.name: control-shadow
shadows.purpose: Select overlay、Slider handle 等小型互動元件的輕量懸浮感。

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Toggle、按鈕 hover 等狀態轉換的預設過渡曲線，約 150-200ms。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 主要操作按鈕，Signal Green 底。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #22c55e; color: #0a0a0b; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius, 10px); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #22c55e; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: 次要操作按鈕，Panel Black 底 + 外框。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #101013; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius, 10px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #e8e8ea; }

components.name: Data Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color: #22c55e; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #101013; color: #e8e8ea; }

components.name: Data Card
components.description: 標準內容卡片，靠明度分層而非陰影。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #101013; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: var(--radius, 10px); padding: 16px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8ea; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: 下拉選單，選項為代碼/數字性質資料。
components.css: .ds-select { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; background: #0a0a0b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-select:focus-within { border-color: #22c55e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34,197,94,0.4); } .ds-select-label { flex: 1; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #e8e8ea; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #16161a; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-toggle[data-checked="true"] { background: #22c55e; } .ds-toggle-handle { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-toggle[data-checked="true"] .ds-toggle-handle { transform: translateX(18px); }

narrative.overview: 介面借用專業交易終端的視覺語言——近黑背景、等寬數字字體、扁平無陰影、細邊框分區——但服務對象不是機構交易員，而是自己記帳追蹤存股的個人投資人。因此語氣要溫和好懂：資訊密度高但不冷峻，數字用等寬字體給出終端感的精確可信度，介面結構與互動保持友善、低學習成本。這不是要模仿 Bloomberg 終端的壓迫感，而是借它「數字說話、資料誠實」的精神，套進一個平易近人的個人工具外殼。
keyCharacteristics: 近黑背景（#0a0a0b）+ 三層 surface 分級，靠明度差而非陰影分區
JetBrains Mono 專門用於數字/代碼類資料，Inter + Noto Sans TC 用於一般文字
單一 Signal Green accent，扁平無陰影為主，僅 Dialog／浮層用陰影標示層級
圓角隨元件層級遞增：badge/chip 最緊（3–4px）→ button/select（8–10px）→ dialog（20px）

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: 全系統只有 Signal Green 一個強調色；紅色只用在「漲」與危險操作語境，不與 Signal Green 並列作為兩個平行的品牌色使用。

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: 任何股價、股數、百分比、股票代號、日期時間戳，一律用 JetBrains Mono；純敘述性文字用 Inter。混用是這個系統辨識度的核心。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 頁面內常駐元件（卡片、按鈕、輸入框）不用陰影；陰影只在元件短暫浮出頁面平面時出現（Dialog、下拉選單）。

dos: Do 用 JetBrains Mono 呈現任何價格、股數、百分比、代碼、時間戳
Do 用三層 surface 明度表達層級，而非新增陰影
Do 保持紅漲綠跌（Alert Red = 漲 / Signal Green = 跌）與台股慣例一致
Do 圓角隨元件暫態程度遞增：常駐小元件方正、浮層元件圓潤
donts: Don't 幫常駐卡片、按鈕、輸入框加陰影
Don't 引入第二個強調色跟 Signal Green 並列成雙品牌色
Don't 把一般敘述文字放進 JetBrains Mono，或把數字類資料放進 Inter
